assays.description: MDR1-MDCKII permeability assay to identify intestinal or CNS permeability. Cells are cultured to form confluent monolayers expressing P-gp, integrity confirmed by measuring trans-epithelial resistance. The rate of compound transport in apical (A)-to-basolateral (B) direction after incubation is determined by LC-MS/MS analysis. The apparent permeability (Papp) and % recovery are calculated as results. The assay has been performed by Enamine biological services, Bienta Ltd.The protocol is publicly available: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.n2bvjne6ngk5/v1
